docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $1,180.98 FILED BY PHAN, OANH AS TO DEFENDANT CHEZ MAMAN ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-01-2020 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - (FEE FOR SERVICE: $100.00) SERVED AUG-26-2020, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT CHEZ MAMAN
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) JOCELYN BULOW, OWNER FILED BY DEFENDANT CHEZ MAMAN
ORDER RE CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT OF OCTOBER 9, 2020 AT 3:30 P.M.

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-01-2020 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO OCT-09-2020 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF OANH PHAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHEZ MAMAN, REPRESENTED BY JOCELYN BULOW, OWNER IS PRESENT. PARTIES REACH SETTLEMENT. DEFENDANT TO PAY PLAINTIFF $462.17. UPON FULL PAYMENT PLAINTIFF AGREES TO DISMISS THIS CASE WITH PREJUDICE. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
ORDER RE: DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE. CASE SETTLED.

DISMISSAL PURSUANT TO SETTLEMENT. NO APPEARANCES. PLAINTIFF, OANH PHAN CALLS AND NOTIFIES THE COURT THAT PAYMENT HAS BEEN RECEIVED AND THAT THE MATTER HAS SETTLED. COMMISSIONER PANG LY; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)
